# Synthetic test fixtures

Every file in this directory is generated by `scripts/make_fixtures.py` and is
**100% synthetic**: the Sinhala dialogue is placeholder text written for these
tests and no copyrighted film subtitle is included anywhere in this repository.

| File | Shape | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `synthetic-nested.zip` | piratelk layout: nested folder, ad `.txt`, UTF-16LE sibling, `__MACOSX/`, `../evil.srt` | nested-depth extraction, traversal rejection, UTF-16 decode |
| `synthetic-flat.zip` | zoom.lk layout: one flat UTF-8-BOM `.srt` | flat zip + BOM + edge-credit stripping |
| `synthetic-rar4.rar` | RAR4 signature only (no data) | proves RAR is routed to the nightly pre-indexer, never unpacked in the Worker |

Regenerate with `python3 scripts/make_fixtures.py` (stdlib only, deterministic).
